sources.entry: Google Allo for Desktop - Native macOS & Windows desktop app for Google Allo.

summary.one_liner: A desktop wrapper app for Google Allo built with Nativefier and Electron, now deprecated and archived because Google shut Allo down.
summary.what_it_does: The project provides a dedicated desktop app for Google Allo, the messaging service, so it can run outside a browser tab. The README says the app is built with Nativefier and Electron (version ^1.7.6 is mentioned) and that the latest release ships light and dark theme versions for Mac, Windows, and Linux. The purpose stated is to leverage the operating system's built-in notification system. The README includes Nativefier command lines for rebuilding the app on each platform, with options for a custom icon, injecting a dark theme CSS file, disabling dev tools, single-instance mode, and a system tray icon (tray is omitted on Linux). It also gives steps for enabling Windows notifications through a Start Menu shortcut and a developer note on setting an AppUserModelId in Electron on Windows 8/10. The README states the project is not affiliated with Google. The top of the README says the project is deprecated and in archive mode because Allo is shutting down.
use_cases: run Google Allo as a standalone desktop app
get OS-native notifications for Allo messages
rebuild a Nativefier desktop wrapper for Mac, Windows, or Linux
apply a dark theme to a wrapped web chat app
keep a messaging app in the system tray
study how to set Electron notifications on Windows
notable: Deprecated: the author archived the project after Google announced Allo's shutdown and points to Android Messages for Desktop instead
Ships light and dark theme builds, with dark-theme.css injected at build time
Windows notification fix using app.setAppUserModelId(process.execPath) in Electron
Single-instance and system tray options in the Nativefier build commands
caveats: Deprecated and in archive mode; Google Allo is shutting down, so the wrapper no longer serves a live service
Windows notifications need a Start Menu shortcut and an action center setting turned on
Not an official Google product and not affiliated with Google
Rebuilding requires Node.js and Nativefier, and the Windows build needs an .ico icon file
